title: Valerie Ransone's 1971 sighting over Northern Illinois University
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Valerie Ransone's 1971 sighting over Northern Illinois University, about 1971 at Northern Illinois University, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 1971 October, it's around 11:00 a.m. and I noticed a strange object above the student union building.
